title: Hyperopia makes a book held close hard to resolve
summary: Hyperopia is the National Eye Institute's name for farsightedness, which makes close things look blurry.
body: Hyperopia, as the National Eye Institute defines it, is the focusing error that leaves a nearby page or toy blurry while distance can stay readable. The December 2025 page lists it as a common focusing error. No diopter number is assigned here.

sources.title: Refractive Errors
sources.author: National Eye Institute
sources.note: Supports hyperopia making nearby objects look blurry.
